pageHeader.title: Players
pageHeader.description: Manage connected players and their permissions

permissions.noModerate: This action requires the players.moderate permission, which this role doesn't have.
permissions.noGmTools: This action requires the players.gm_tools permission, which this role doesn't have.
permissions.noBridgeCommand: This action requires the bridge.command permission, which this role doesn't have.

summary.rosterTip: Players you've connected with before, now offline. Someone online right now isn't counted here until they disconnect — that's why this can read 0 while a player card is live above it.

roster.onlineEmptyDesc: Players appear here when they connect.
roster.rosterEmptyNoSearchDesc: Players you’ve seen before will appear here once they disconnect.
roster.whitelistUnavailableFallback: The account database could not be read for this server.
roster.whitelistEmptyNoSearchDesc: Add an account with a username and password.

dossier.noTargetDesc: Pick a player from the roster to view their dossier, or type a username under <1>› Manual target</1>.

vitals.noTarget: Select a player to see their live status.
vitals.unavailable: Live status is unavailable for this player.
vitals.otherStatsTip: Shown as raw numbers, not a bar like the vitals above: PanelBridge sends these values, but which of them use a 0-1 scale versus 0-100 hasn't been confirmed against the game itself for every one of them. A colored bar would have to guess the scale, and a confidently wrong severity is worse than no severity at all.

actionTiles.voiceBanTooltip: Mute or unmute a player from in-game voice chat. They stay connected, but can't talk in proximity voice.
actionTiles.steamIdBanTooltip: Ban a player by their Steam ID, even when they're offline. Works without needing them to be connected.
actionTiles.addUserTooltip: Create a new account on the server (username + password). Mostly used for whitelist-only servers.
actionTiles.unbanTooltip: Lift a ban by username so the player can rejoin.
actionTiles.unbanSteamIdTooltip: Lift a SteamID ban. Pick from the list of banned IDs or paste one manually.

banDialog.title: Ban Player
banDialog.banIpTip: Also blocks the IP, not just the account — can affect others on the same network, and this panel has no way to review or lift IP bans separately.

banConfirm.title: Are you absolutely sure?
banConfirm.description: This will permanently ban <1>{{player}}</1> from the server.
banConfirm.descriptionWithIp: This will permanently ban <1>{{player}}</1> from the server and their IP address.

teleportDialog.title: Teleport Player
teleportDialog.zTip: The building floor, not a height — 0 is ground level, higher is an upper floor.

voiceBanDialog.title: Voice Ban
voiceBanDialog.description: Mute or unmute a player's voice chat

steamIdBanDialog.title: Ban by SteamID
steamIdBanDialog.description: Ban a player by their Steam ID (useful for offline bans)

addUserDialog.title: Add User
addUserDialog.description: Create a new user account for whitelist servers. Build 42 allows an empty password.

spawn.giveItemsDescWithPlayer: Weapons, food, medical, tools — give as many items as you want to <1>{{player}}</1> without closing the dialog.
spawn.giveItemsDescNoPlayer: Pick a player first, then browse the full item catalog to fill their inventory.
spawn.spawnVehiclesDescWithPlayer: Sedans, trucks, emergency, military — spawn one after another near <1>{{player}}</1>.
spawn.spawnVehiclesDescNoPlayer: Spawns at the caller's position — select a player to spawn vehicles near them instead.
spawn.giveXpDescNoPlayer: Grant experience to the selected player

powers.introNoPlayer: Toggle special abilities for the selected player.
powers.killTip: Also turns off God Mode first, even if the kill itself fails — it isn't turned back on automatically.
powers.killConfirmDesc: This immediately ends {{player}}'s character. On a permadeath server there is no undo, no respawn as the same character, and no restore. Type their username below to confirm you mean to do this to them.

notes.selectPlayerEmpty: Select a player to view or add notes
notes.commonTagsHint: Common tags: trusted, suspicious, new, vip, builder, griefer, afk. Up to 10 tags, 24 characters each.
notes.deleteConfirmDesc: The admin note and tags saved for {{player}} will be permanently deleted. This cannot be undone.
notes.activityLogTruncatedHint: Showing the most recent {{count}} entries -- older activity may not be shown.
notes.filterAria: Filter activity logs by player name
notes.noLogsRow: No activity logs yet — moderation actions taken on this player (bans, kicks, whitelist changes) will appear here.

importExport.title: Import/Export Character
importExport.description: Export or restore a player's XP, perks, and skills via PanelBridge.
importExport.bridgeOfflineDesc: Character export and import require PanelBridge to be connected. <1>Open Bridge Setup</1>
importExport.exportDesc: Export XP, perks, skills, and inventory
importExport.importDesc: Restore XP, perks, skills, and exported inventory
importExport.autoExportDesc: Automatically save a character backup when players join the server

importConfirm.title: Overwrite {{player}}'s character?
importConfirm.description: This replaces {{player}}'s XP, perks, skills, traits, inventory, and worn items with the pasted data. {{player}}'s current state is saved to Saved Exports first, so you can restore it from there if this is the wrong player or the wrong file.

toasts.bridgeUnverifiedDesc: {{action}} was sent, but the mod could not confirm it took effect.
toasts.bridgeOldBridgeDesc: {{action}} may have worked, but this PanelBridge mod version doesn't report back whether it did. Update the mod to confirm results.
toasts.passwordLengthError: Password must be empty or at least 4 characters
toasts.invalidSteamIdDesc: Steam IDs must contain exactly 17 digits.
toasts.invalidJsonDesc: The character data is not valid JSON format
toasts.characterImportedDescNoneApplied: None of the submitted skills or items were applied to {{player}}. The data may not match this server's mods or item definitions.
toasts.fileTooLargeDesc: Character data file must be under 5MB

loadErrors.notesAndStats: Failed to load player notes and stats.
loadErrors.toolsAndReference: Failed to load player tools and reference data.
